If this was the bill, it made sense. ...Though perhaps the question I ought to be asking was how I had failed to burn up completely. en.html: Fierce battle spirit boiling, armor shining like a star, she came toward us. That speed. That terrifying power. She would come straight in and shatter me with one blow. —This time, I would be killed. No way to intercept her. No way to defend. From any direction I considered it, no way to resist. Last time we had at least started on equal terms, and still I had lost. This time even that was gone. Muramasa and I were badly damaged, our fighting ability reduced. The Silver Star had not a scratch. How was I supposed to face her like this? How was I supposed to win? What, some magic method? A miracle? There was none.◆ —No. There was one. Neither magic nor a miracle. A way to win. One only. —Yes. Kageaki Minato had one way to kill Hikaru Minato. I had learned it before entering this fight. Knew it, and still failed to make the final decision. It was not too late. Not yet. I could still fight. Then now was when I had to do it. —Do it. Use the one way that remained.
en.text:
Fierce battle spirit boiling, armor shining like a star, she came toward us.
That speed. That terrifying power.

She would come straight in and shatter me with one blow.

—This time, I would be killed.

No way to intercept her. No way to defend.
From any direction I considered it, no way to resist.

Last time we had at least started on equal terms, and still I had lost. This time even that was gone. Muramasa and I were badly damaged, our fighting ability reduced. The Silver Star had not a scratch.

How was I supposed to face her like this?

How was I supposed to win?

What, some magic method? A miracle?

There was none.◆

—No.

There was one.

Neither magic nor a miracle. A way to win.

One only.

—Yes.
Kageaki Minato had one way to kill Hikaru Minato.

I had learned it before entering this fight. Knew it, and still failed to make the final decision.

It was not too late.
Not yet.

I could still fight.

Then now was when I had to do it.

—Do it.

Use the one way that remained.

ja.html: 猛気を滾たぎらせ、星の輝きを放つ騎体が迫り来る。 　凄まじいまでの速度スピード。空恐ろしいまでの勢威パワー。 　あのままに俺を襲い、一撃をもって砕くのであろう。 　――今度こそ斃される。 　迎撃の方法はなく、防御の方法もない。 　あらゆる意味で、対抗の方法がない。 　五分の勝負であった先刻さえ、遂に競り負けた。 　今度は五分ではない。俺と村正は大きく損傷し戦闘 能力を減じている一方、銀星号は全くの無傷。 　これでどうすれば立ち向かえるのか。 　どうすれば勝てるのか。 　そんな魔法か奇跡のような方法があるのか？ 　無い。◆ 　 　――――――――――――――――――否。 　有る。 　魔法でもなければ奇跡でもないが。 　勝つ方法はある。 　たった一つ。 　――そう。 　湊斗景明が湊斗光を殺す方法は一つだけ。 　この戦いに臨む前、それを知った。 　知っていたのに、最後の決断を欠いた。 　今なら間に合う。 　まだ。 　まだ俺は戦える。 　だから今、やらなくてはならない。 　――――やろう。 　たった一つの方法を行おう。
ja.text:
猛気を滾たぎらせ、星の輝きを放つ騎体が迫り来る。
　凄まじいまでの速度スピード。空恐ろしいまでの勢威パワー。

　あのままに俺を襲い、一撃をもって砕くのであろう。

　――今度こそ斃される。

　迎撃の方法はなく、防御の方法もない。
　あらゆる意味で、対抗の方法がない。

　五分の勝負であった先刻さえ、遂に競り負けた。
　今度は五分ではない。俺と村正は大きく損傷し戦闘
能力を減じている一方、銀星号は全くの無傷。

　これでどうすれば立ち向かえるのか。

　どうすれば勝てるのか。

　そんな魔法か奇跡のような方法があるのか？

　無い。◆
　
　――――――――――――――――――否。

　有る。

　魔法でもなければ奇跡でもないが。
　勝つ方法はある。

　たった一つ。

　――そう。
　湊斗景明が湊斗光を殺す方法は一つだけ。

　この戦いに臨む前、それを知った。
　知っていたのに、最後の決断を欠いた。

　今なら間に合う。
　まだ。

　まだ俺は戦える。

　だから今、やらなくてはならない。

　――――やろう。

　たった一つの方法を行おう。

en.html: The mind that had been made of blood, flesh, and something else was hammered. Forged. Turning into black steel. Firm. Hard. Strong. Unyielding. One lump of iron. Nothing in it left to waver. ...Yes. This would do. Now I would reach true no-self. All the foolish thoughts gone. One purpose remaining. Kageaki Minato, by nature farther from it than anybody, passed through the ritual of erasing himself—◆ and bent himself into the shape of a hero.
en.text:
The mind that had been made of blood, flesh, and something else
was hammered. Forged.

Turning into black steel.

Firm.
Hard.

Strong.
Unyielding.

One lump of iron. Nothing in it left to waver.

...Yes. This would do.

Now I would reach true no-self.

All the foolish thoughts gone. One purpose remaining.

Kageaki Minato, by nature farther from it than anybody,
passed through the ritual of erasing himself—◆

and bent himself into the shape of a hero.

ja.html: 血と肉と何かで出来ていた心が、 　打ち上げられ。鍛え上げられ。 　漆黒の鋼に変わってゆく。 　固く。 　硬く。 　強く。 　靭つよく。 　揺れ動かぬ、鉄の塊に。 　……これで良い。 　これで正真の無我境へ至る。 　全ての愚念は消え、残るは唯一義。 　本来それとは誰よりも縁遠い湊斗景明が、 　自己の抹殺という儀礼を経て、◆ 　 　英雄たるものに曲がり成る。
ja.text:
血と肉と何かで出来ていた心が、
　打ち上げられ。鍛え上げられ。

　漆黒の鋼に変わってゆく。

　固く。
　硬く。

　強く。
　靭つよく。

　揺れ動かぬ、鉄の塊に。

　……これで良い。

　これで正真の無我境へ至る。

　全ての愚念は消え、残るは唯一義。

　本来それとは誰よりも縁遠い湊斗景明が、
　自己の抹殺という儀礼を経て、◆
　
　英雄たるものに曲がり成る。
